title: Finished houses reach the town faster when two land together
items: Nothing you can see changes in the scene itself. Two building changes that rebuilt different houses no longer hold each other up: the build loop now merges the town's asset list entry by entry, where before a second house waited a whole extra run to catch up with the first.

When a shared recipe moved on both sides, the affected houses are rebuilt on the combined version and kept only if they come out identical; anything that would look different still goes back to a full run.
